one_line: Open on a parent emergency, fail with the old way on screen, then show the fix and one comment word.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a close-up of a girl of about 3 at an airport table, arms up, mouth open; 0:01 she lifts a phone. Said and subtitled: 'אמאאאא אני חייבת פיפי!'. Headline all Reel: 'POV: הילדה שלך פתאום צריכה פיפי...'.
q1_hook.why: The child shouts the parent emergency to the camera, an instant, familiar problem (H1, K6, H4). The voice and the subtitle start together, and the POV headline names the situation (H6, T3). The result is unknown until the end, an open question (H5).

beats.what: Close-up of the girl shouting, a phone lifted; 'אמאאאא אני חייבת פיפי!'
beats.why: The emergency, spoken by the child.

beats.what: The girl runs across an airport hall; the family walks to the toilets; 'דווקא באמצע שדה התעופה'
A stall door, a bowl, a bin full of paper; 'ואני רק מקווה שנמצא שירותים נורמליים'
beats.why: The unpleasant stall is the pain.

beats.what: Hands lay paper on the seat and it keeps slipping; 'אני מנסה לסדר אותו שוב ושוב ושוב'
beats.why: The old way fails on screen.

beats.what: A stroller with a net bag and a white pouch; 'איך שכחתי שיש לי את זה על העגלה?!!'
beats.why: The turn, with the product still unseen.

beats.what: She unfolds a white seat reducer; 'מקטין אסלה מתקפל שהזמנתי מעלי אקספרס', 'קטן, נייד ותמיד איתנו'
beats.why: The product is named and shown at once.

beats.what: It sits on the bowl; the girl leans on it; 'פותחים בשנייה מצמידים עם הוואקום וזהו', 'יושבת בנוחות'
beats.why: The fix works in the same stall.

beats.what: The girl washes her hands, then runs down the corridor; 'רוצות קישור? תכתבו לי ׳אסלה׳'
beats.why: A happy ending and one ask.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: The comment word 'אסלה' for a link (0:34 to 0:36, spoken, on screen, and in the caption). The caption opens with 'כל אמא שנכנסה פעם לשירותים ציבוריים עם ילד מכירה', a moment to send.
q2_flow.why: A full mini story: want, failure, turn, fix, payoff (K2, H5). The pain is shown for 8 s before the product, so the solution lands harder (R3). The product appears only at 0:19, so the middle holds on the failing paper, which is a long wait (R1, H2). The last shot is a happy payoff (R4).

q3_cta.what: 0:34 to 0:36 (said and subtitled): 'רוצות קישור? תכתבו לי ׳אסלה׳ ואני שולחת ♡'. Caption: 'רוצות לינק? תעקבו אחריי ותגיבו ״אסלה״ ואני שולחת לכן בפרטי 💌'. No price, no brand.
q3_cta.why: One keyword that delivers the link, said and shown at the end, after the value, and repeated in the caption (C3, C6, C2). It sits over the bottom 35% (F2). The caption adds a follow ask, a second action (C1).

q4_shown.what: The stroller pouch at 0:16; the white folding seat reducer unfolded in hands 0:19 to 0:22; placed on the bowl 0:22; the girl leaning on it and sitting 0:24 to 0:29. Before, the bin and slipping paper, 0:08 to 0:16. No price, no brand.
q4_shown.why: The failure comes first and the fix is shown in the same stall, a clear before and after with the child using it (S1, K2). The pouch and the unfold show how it packs (F4). No price (S3). A toddler on a public toilet is what LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 13 shots in 36 s (2.8 s each), handheld straight cuts on the voice; no speed changes seen. The voiceover reads the on-screen text. The headline stays all 36 s, with subtitles below it. Ends on the child running away down a corridor.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 2 to 3 s inside a story is a moderate pace (E2, R3). The voice and the text match, so it works with sound on or off (E4, T1). Two text blocks stay all Reel (T2). It ends on the ask and a happy run (E8).

q6_topic.what: A folding toilet seat reducer for a toddler in a public toilet at the airport. Serves parents who face the same moment on trips and outings.
q6_topic.why: A moment every parent of a toddler knows (K6, K3), with a calm, real solution and a trip context, a flight (K7). The humour is the child's shout and the overflowing bin. A routine with a high 'send to a friend' value (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone: a close selfie-style shot of the girl, a wide of the hall from behind, a POV into the stall, close hands on paper, a static shot of the seat on the bowl, a corridor wide. Airport light.
q7_filmed.why: A POV from the adult's view puts the viewer in the stall (F5, K2). Real places and mess feel lived-in (H8). Some shots are shaky or dim (F7). The headline and subtitles fill the middle and lower frame (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: A headline for all 36 s, centred at about 60 to 66% of the frame height, 2 lines: 'POV:' then 'הילדה שלך פתאום צריכה פיפי בשירותים ציבוריים 🫠'. Subtitles below at about 75 to 82%, white with a dark outline, 2 lines, matching the voice: 'אמאאאא אני חייבת פיפי!' (0:00), 'מקטין אסלה מתקפל שהזמנתי מעלי אקספרס' (0:20), 'רוצות קישור ? תכתבו לי ׳אסלה׳ ואני שולחת ♡' (0:34).
q8_text.caption: 'כל אמא שנכנסה פעם לשירותים ציבוריים עם ילד מכירה את הסיטואציה הזאת 😩😂'. About 110 words: a tip on the steps, the pouch, 'הוא מעלי אקספרס', 'רוצות לינק? תעקבו אחריי ותגיבו ״אסלה״'. No hashtags, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: The POV headline states the topic in the first second, and subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T3, T1). Both sit in the middle and bottom 35% (T4, F2, T2). The first caption line is a relatable moment and the CTA repeats, no hashtags (T7, C6). No disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: The product appears only at 0:19; the dirty-toilet shots may repel some viewers; a child on a toilet and the child's face; two stacked text blocks all along; no price or brand; follow and comment asks together.
lumebook_takeaway: A POV headline of a parent moment, an object instead of a child, the book as the turn near the middle, one comment word at the end. Hands only.
not_verified: Whether the link is an affiliate link (no disclosure seen); the share of the 914 comments that are the keyword; whether the child's first line is scripted; music (none evident). Correction: the child's face is on camera at 0:00 to 0:03 and 0:30 to 0:32, so face_on_camera is not 'no face'; the pouch on the stroller shows at 0:16, the product itself at 0:19.
